title: Rate Committee Bulletin — Setting the Contract Rate on Farm Real Estate Loans at Closing and Conversion
content:
The contract rate of a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage is set at closing and again at a rate conversion as follows.

## Clauses in force

**1. Starting rate.** At closing and at a rate conversion, the starting rate of an adjustable or fixed product is its initial rate from the current rate sheet; the starting rate of the variable product (the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage) is the Association Variable Base Rate in effect that day, as registered in the Operating Lines of Credit rate setting, plus the product's variable-rate spread.

**2. Discounts.** From the starting rate are taken the product's autopay discount while automatic debit is enrolled on the loan, and the product's young-farmer land discount when the member holds a StartRight Operating Line in active status on that day (at least one of the member's operating lines on the StartRight Operating Line product in active status on the rate effective date).

**3. Combination, rounding and floor.** The two discounts are added, the sum is capped at the product's discount cap, and the result is rounded to 3 decimal places and may not be lower than the product's rate floor.

## Clauses no longer in force

> The following two clauses of this bulletin are **no longer in force** and have been superseded by the current basis:
>
> - "The young-farmer discount, once given, stays for the fixed period even if the StartRight line later closes, and is re-tested only at a conversion."
> - "Enrolling in or cancelling autopay adds or removes the autopay discount from that day without restarting any fixed period."

## Clause 1 to 3 restated

| Element | Adjustable or fixed product | Variable product |
|---|---|---|
| Starting rate | initial rate from the current sheet | Association Variable Base Rate in effect that day plus the variable-rate spread |
| Autopay discount | taken while automatic debit is enrolled | taken while automatic debit is enrolled |
| Young-farmer land discount | taken when a StartRight Operating Line is in active status that day | taken when a StartRight Operating Line is in active status that day |
| Discounts together | added, capped at the discount cap | added, capped at the discount cap |
| Result | rounded to 3 decimals, never below the rate floor | rounded to 3 decimals, never below the rate floor |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical)

A loan closes on the FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage with automatic debit enrolled, and the member holds a StartRight Operating Line in active status that day. Starting rate 6.85 percent; autopay discount 0.10 and young-farmer land discount 0.5 add to 0.60, capped at 0.5; 6.85 less 0.5 is 6.350 percent, above the 5.25 floor. The contract rate is 6.350 percent.

On the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage, suppose the Association Variable Base Rate in effect on the closing day were 6.400 percent (an assumed figure): starting rate 6.400 plus 0.25 is 6.650; with automatic debit enrolled and no StartRight line, 0.10 is taken off, giving 6.550 percent, above the 5.0 floor.

superseded_clauses: Enrolling in or cancelling autopay adds or removes the autopay discount from that day without restarting any fixed period.
The young-farmer discount, once given, stays for the fixed period even if the StartRight line later closes, and is re-tested only at a conversion.
